title: Custom GIS Dashboard
intro: An interactive web dashboard with maps, filters and charts so your team can explore data on its own.

items.title: Discovery & requirements
items.desc: Kickoff call, user goals, data inventory, wireframe of the dashboard layout.

items.title: Data preparation
items.desc: Cleaning, joining and geocoding source data; set up optimized map-ready layers.

items.title: Dashboard build
items.desc: Interactive map, filters, search, summary charts and pop-ups, styled to your brand.

items.title: Testing & QA
items.desc: Cross-browser and mobile checks, data accuracy review, performance tuning.

items.title: Handoff & training
items.desc: Deployment, user guide, admin notes and a 45-minute walkthrough session.
